tasks.title: Make task updates feel smooth
tasks.description: Improve board updates so task actions settle naturally without the page feeling refreshed or visually rebuilt.

tasks.title: Add milestone creation
tasks.description: Add a way to create a new full-width milestone directly from the Milestones view.

tasks.title: Add mini-tasks inside milestones
tasks.description: Allow milestones to contain actionable mini-tasks and calculate completion automatically.

tasks.title: Place Unassigned at the end
tasks.description: Keep contributor columns first and render the Unassigned column as the final board lane.

tasks.title: Copy a task description on card click
tasks.description: Clicking a task card should copy its description while preserving menus, drag and drop, and editor actions.

tasks.title: Create a New Milestone action in Milestones
tasks.description: Place a clear New Milestone button inside the Milestones view so users can create a workstream and its mini-tasks without leaving that page.
